## ✨ Highlights

- 🔏 **The VM images boot with Secure Boot on**: the UKIs on the qcow2s' and the image factory's images are signed with the release key, like every update already was. With the Janus release certificate enrolled in its firmware, a node boots only what Janus signed, from its very first boot. A guide explains what is signed, how to check both slots, and the Proxmox VE procedure ([#437](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/pull/437), [Secure Boot](https://janus.sw-servers.net/docs/guide/secure-boot.md)).
- 🛡️ **See where Secure Boot is on**: a node reports what its firmware does with Secure Boot. `janusctl version` prints `Secure Boot: on`, `off` or `none`, and the Controller shows a **Secure Boot** badge on each machine of Hypervisors › Machines ([#439](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/pull/439)).
- 🔁 **An undrain right after a member's reboot goes through**: the Controller sent it on its connection from before the reboot and lost it, leaving the member drained. The cluster engine now tries such calls once more ([#441](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/pull/441), fixes [#438](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/issues/438)).
- 🧳 **VMware, bare metal and Raspberry Pi wait for testers**: these targets were never checked on real hardware, so they are no longer built. The image factory shows them greyed out, with a **Need tester** form to volunteer ([#436](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/pull/436)).

## ⚙️ Node

- **`VersionResponse.secure_boot`** ([#439](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/pull/439)): `ON`, `OFF` (a UEFI boot that enforces nothing, a firmware without Secure Boot included) or `NO_UEFI`, read from the node's UEFI variables. A node from an older release says nothing.
- **Packet capture's socket library**: mdlayher/packet 1.2.0 and mdlayher/socket 0.7.0 ([#442](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/pull/442)).

## 🖥️ Controller

- **Secure Boot on Hypervisors › Machines** ([#439](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/pull/439)):
  - On each machine's card and in the list's State column: a **Secure Boot** badge with a shield when the firmware enforces it, a crossed-out shield when it doesn't, and nothing for a node too old to say.
  - `secure_boot` (`on`, `off`, `none`) in `GET /api/machines[/{id}]`. The machine's history records a change ("Secure Boot off → on").
- **Clusters: calls that can safely run twice are retried on a dead connection** ([#441](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/pull/441)):
  - Drain, undrain, ClusterSet and the reads go through when they're sent right after a member's reboot. Before, they failed with `connection reset by peer`.
  - Applies, uploads, pulls and imports are never sent twice. `janusctl cluster` gets the same change.
- **Single sign-on**: go-oidc 3.21.0 and x/oauth2 0.37.0 ([#442](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/pull/442)).

## 💻 janusctl

- **`janusctl version`** ends with `Secure Boot: on|off|none - not a UEFI boot` ([#439](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/pull/439)).

## 📦 Images and releases

- **Signed images** ([#437](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/pull/437)):
  - Every UKI on the qcow2s' ESP is signed: `\EFI\BOOT\BOOTX64.EFI` and both slots' `\JANUS\UKI-<slot>.EFI`. So are the factory's images from this release on, and the VMDK and ISO when those targets come back.
  - Publishing checks every EFI binary of every image (`hack/uki-verify.sh`) and refuses an unsigned one.
  - A signed image boots the same with Secure Boot off.
- **Publishing a release** ([#435](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/pull/435), fixes [#433](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/issues/433)):
  - A release stays a draft until all its files are uploaded, and a published release is never changed by a re-run.
  - A rebuild of the same commit gives the same files, except for the signed UKIs and the images that carry them.
- **Suspended targets** ([#436](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/pull/436)):
  - Nothing builds the VMware VMDK, the bare-metal ISO or the Raspberry Pi images anymore, and the image factory refuses them. Their recipes, tests and docs stay, ready for whoever tests them.
  - The issue forms *Need tester* (one per target) and *Extension request* are new.
- **Build images**: Alpine 3.24.3 for HAProxy's static build and the extensions; refreshed `debian:trixie-slim`, `golang:1.27.3-trixie` and Playwright images; the frontends' and the docs' npm packages ([#442](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/pull/442)).

## 📖 Docs

- **[Secure Boot](https://janus.sw-servers.net/docs/guide/secure-boot.md)** (User guide › Operate) covers:
  - what Janus signs, and the release certificate with its fingerprint;
  - why both slots must hold signed UKIs, and how to check them from the hypervisor;
  - the Proxmox VE procedure (the certificate as PK, KEK and db in the machine's own EFI variables), libvirt in short;
  - where the state shows, and what changes on a node.
- The README's Go badge names the Go that builds Janus (1.27.3), kept equal to `go.mod`'s toolchain by a test ([#440](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/pull/440), fixes [#432](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/issues/432)).

## 🧪 Tests

- `qemu-secureboot-test` boots a whole signed disk image under Secure Boot and asks its node: `janusctl version` must say `Secure Boot: on`, with zero AVC denials. The kexec tests check `off` ([#437](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/pull/437), [#439](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/pull/439)).

## ⚠️ Upgrade notes

- **Turning Secure Boot on** is a firmware change, made node by node. Both of a node's slots must hold signed UKIs first. That's true of a node installed from this release's images, and of any node updated twice since it was installed ([the guide](https://janus.sw-servers.net/docs/guide/secure-boot.md#before-turning-it-on)).
- **The Controller creates its machines with Secure Boot off**: a member it recycles or replaces comes back without it.
- **The Secure Boot badge needs both sides updated**: the Controller, and the node, which must run this release to report its state.
